prerequisites: Having completed all previous courses foreseen in the master's curriculum.

learning_outcomes.text: Apply the knowledge acquired during the Master's to solve real mechatronic problems encountered in industry.
Gather all necessary information relevant to the posed problem to solve it as efficiently as possible.
Develop a mechatronic prototype to demonstrate that the proposed solution is valid to address the posed problem.
Conduct tests and trials to verify the correct functioning of all parts of the system, considering their reliability, robustness, and efficiency.
Write a well-organized report that includes all reasoning leading to the final solution presented.
Present the results and defend opinions to questions from other experts on the topic.

assessment_methods.method: Master's Thesis work, documentation, and defense

assessment_rules: The tribunal will evaluate the originality, quality, and relevance of the work to the degree's competencies. Clarity, validity of ideas and reasoning, use of appropriate norms and methodologies, structure and presentation of the report, and the student's ability to respond to questions will be assessed. The presentation should last between 15 and 25 minutes in a public session, followed by questions from the tribunal. The tribunal will deliberate in private to determine the grade, which will then be announced to the student in a public session. If health conditions require it, non-face-to-face evaluation methods may be included, with students being informed of any changes.
institution: Universidad de Oviedo - Máster Universitario en Ingeniería Mecatrónica (EPI Gijón)
